Regional Finance Controller
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia · full time · MYR 25,000 / month
Site Location: Kuala Lumpur
Cost Centre: Finance & Risk Management
Reporting to: Group Head of Finance / Group Financial Controller
Secondary Reporting to (if applicable): Country GM
Position Summary
As a key member of OBU finance, you will lead a team and oversee the financial activities of the Company,
including financial reporting, taxation, cash flow management, audit, budgeting and forecasting, cost management
and ensuring compliance with financial regulations for both Malaysia & Thailand.
Reporting to the Group Head of Finance / Group Financial Controller, you will play an important role in the
leadership of the Finance Function of Malaysia and Thailand, ensuring the Company's financial stability,
compliance and strategic financial planning. This position requires a combination of technical expertise and
leadership skills to contribute to the Company's financial success and sustainability.
Responsibilities
Strategic Business Partnering
• Collaborate closely with Director, MY & TH and Plant Heads / Plant Managers in both regions to analyze
business performance, product profitability and cost structure.
• Provide financial modeling and analysis to support key strategic decisions, including pricing strategies, new
market entries and etc.
• Challenge the status quo by identifying operational efficiencies, cost-saving opportunities and revenue
enhancement initiatives.
Financial Analysis and Reporting
• Monthly preparation of the Group's financial and management reports, analysis of key financial areas such as
MTD/YTD financial performance, AR/AP turnover, sales to direct labor ratio and space productivity to provide
useful insight for improvement.
• Prepare and analyze financial statements, including balance sheet, income statements and cash flow
statements
• Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records and reports
• Manage and supervise the finance team on day-to-day activities such as General Ledger, Accounts
Receivables, Accounts Payables, Fixed Assets, Inventory and Costing functions
• Assist in simulation work and other ad-hoc duties where appropriate.
Product Margin Analysis & Standard Costing
• Prepare and provide monthly costing reports and margin analysis, work closely with operations to maintain the
accuracy of standard product costing, analysis on product cost and margin, highlight the key areas to be
improved to operation and sales team to achieve better margin.
• Ensure compliance with Group costing policy.
• Standard cost rollup and evaluation to ensure accuracy in costing.
Taxation
• Liaise with tax agent for annual tax submission, tax estimation, utilization of tax incentives etc.
• Optimization of tax
• Maintain transfer pricing documentation
Inventory and Cash Flow Management
• Analysis on inventory turnover days.
• Analysis on aged inventory, to work closely with planning, sales and purchasing department to clear the aged
inventory.
• Monthly management of cash flow, monitoring and control of cash conversion cycle.
• Forecast cash flow positions, related borrowing needs and available funds for investment
• Optimize cash management procedures to ensure liquidity and meet financial obligations
• Monitor and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
• Monitor receivables and work with the sales team on collection

• Work with the procurement team on credit terms to improve cash flows
Budgeting & Forecasting
• Collaborate with department heads to develop departmental budgets and forecasts
• Monitor budgets, expenditures, and costs, providing variance analysis and recommending corrective actions as
necessary
• Work closely with department heads to track and control expenses within budgetary limits
• Analyze financial data and trends to provide insights and recommendations to the senior management team
• Contribute to the development of cost-saving strategies
Financial Process Improvement
• Identify opportunities for process improvements in financial operations
• Implement efficient financial procedures and systems to enhance accuracy and productivity
• Streamline financial reporting processes
• Lead the finance team and collaborate with other departments in the integration of ERP systems, financial
software and data analytics tools for streamlined financial processes
Compliance with Financial Regulations
• Ensure compliance with local and international financial reporting standards, and local laws and regulations on
financial related areas
• Manage internal controls and financial procedures to maintain compliance and mitigate risks
• Liaise with auditors and regulatory authorities during financial audits
Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate financial information effectively to non-finance stakeholders
• Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making
• Build and maintain relationships with external partners, such as banks, vendors, tax agents and auditors
Experience
• Minimum 15 years' experience in accounting in the manufacturing sector, with at least 8 years in managerial
capacity
• Strong cost accounting knowledge and several years of working closely with the operations team in a factory are
essential
• Strong command of the English language
• High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis and presentations
• Able to lead the finance team and work with other departments to implement applications and/or improve
processes.
• Proven expertise in financial planning, analysis, and budgeting processes.
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills with a strategic mindset.
Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
Competencies
Technical
• Accounting (IFRS)
• Internal Controls
• Manufacturing Costing
• Management Reporting, Analysis, Budgeting
• Governance
• Taxation
Non-Technical
• Organized, good eye for details and error-free work
• Positive attitude, fast learning, adaptable and strong initiative
• Performance and results driven
• Analytical and solution focused
• Customer and stakeholder oriented
• Agile and innovative
• Resourcefulness and cost conscious
• Developing self and others
• Governance and ethics
Leadership (if applicable)

• Mentoring and retaining high-performing teams.
• Cultural Agility
• Change agent
• Ethical Leadership
• Excellent influencing skill

Sales Manager in Indonesia
full time · IDR 35,000,000 – 40,000,000 / month
Sales Manager – Indonesia
(Indonesian Citizen | Based in Indonesia)
Job Highlights
• Good working environment
• Excellent benefits
• Outstanding career development opportunities
Do you thrive in building strong customer partnerships and driving market growth? Join us as a Sales Manager –
Indonesia, where you'll champion our flavour solutions, manage key accounts, and expand the client's footprint in
one of the most exciting food markets in Asia.
What You'll Do
As the Sales Manager – Indonesia, you will play a key role in supporting our Regional Sales Lead to grow our
presence in this strategic market. Your responsibilities include:
• Driving sales growth by managing key customers and developing new business opportunities.
• Working closely with appointed distributors through joint visits, pipeline reviews, and effective execution of sales
action plans.
• Building strong customer relationships and providing commercial support for flavour projects.
• Collaborating with our Flavourists, Applications, QA, and Regulatory teams to deliver samples, trials, and
technical solutions that meet customer needs.
• Monitoring market intelligence, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities to support strategic planning.
• Managing sales forecasts, project pipelines, and reporting with accuracy and discipline.
• Supporting regulatory and documentation requirements for BPOM, Halal, and importation processes (via
distributors or internal teams).
• Ensuring smooth coordination of orders, deliveries, and credit matters with internal departments.
What We're Looking For:
We're seeking a passionate, driven, and commercially savvy individual who excels in a fast-paced,
customer-centric environment. You should be someone who:
• Has 3–5 years of experience in B2B sales, ideally in flavours, food ingredients, or F&B manufacturing.
• Understands flavour applications, product development cycles, or has strong exposure to technical-commercial
discussions.
• Demonstrates a proven ability to build long-term customer relationships and convert leads or development
pipelines into sales results.
• Possesses strong communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.
• Has experience managing or supporting distributors, regional accounts, or importers in Indonesia.
• Is highly proactive, independent, and able to work remotely while staying aligned with regional objectives.
• Is organised, disciplined, and able to manage multiple projects, forecasts, and timelines.
• Is willing to travel frequently for customer visits, market development, and distributor coordination.
• Must be an Indonesian citizen and based in Indonesia to support local operations.
Why Join Us?
• Be part of a growing, innovation-driven flavour company
• Work in a creative, collaborative environment where food meets science
• Opportunities to engage directly with customers and bring flavour concepts to life

P02 ·

GTM Marketing Manager / Lead
full time
Why this role exists
The client is an AI-powered fulfilment and logistics ecosystem built for fast-growing e-commerce brands. From one
platform, merchants run global fulfilment, cross-border shipping, and AI logistics intelligence, with AI reducing
errors, lowering costs, and continuously optimising fulfilment and shipping as they scale globally.
We help e-commerce sellers worldwide achieve intelligent logistics management, customs compliance, and
fulfillment automation, and we are a core infrastructure partner for small and medium-sized cross-border sellers
entering the global market.
As our business continues to expand into North America, we are looking for a GTM Marketing Manager who can
work independently and deeply understands the US market, to become a core executor of our US and overseas
GTM strategy.
Responsibilities
1. Marketing Strategy & GTM Planning
• Develop and execute the client's integrated marketing strategy for the US and other markets, aligned with the
company's business growth goals and sales pipeline targets.
• Continuously research US e-commerce logistics market trends and competitor strategies, producing valuable
market insight reports.
• Work with the product team on GTM launch planning for new features/services, defining core messaging and
promotion plans.
2. Online Performance Marketing
• Plan, run, and continuously optimize paid advertising across Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads,
etc., rigorously tracking core metrics such as ROAS, CPA, and CPL.
• Lead the SEO content strategy, using Ahrefs / SEMrush for keyword research and competitive analysis to drive
organic traffic growth.
• Manage EDM marketing and marketing automation workflows (HubSpot), including lead nurturing, automated
outreach, and conversion tracking.
• Manage content updates and CRO (conversion rate optimization) for the official website and landing pages.
3. Brand & Content Operations
• Plan and execute the client's social media content operations in the overseas market (LinkedIn, Twitter/X,
YouTube) to raise brand awareness and community influence.
• Create English marketing content, including blogs, case studies, emails, and landing page copy.
• Coordinate internal teams such as design and product, as well as external vendors, to ensure consistency of
brand visuals and messaging.
4. Offline Activities & Events
• Plan and execute key industry trade shows, brand promotion activities, and webinars in the US and other
markets.
• Manage event-related budgets and external vendors to ensure events run smoothly and achieve the expected
exposure and customer acquisition goals.
5. Data Analysis & Cross-Department Collaboration
• Build marketing data dashboards and regularly report US marketing KPIs (MQL, SQL, Pipeline, CAC, ROI) to
management.
• Collaborate closely with the sales team to optimize the MQL-to-SQL conversion process, ensuring marketing
and sales goals are aligned.
• Make effective use of AI tools (such as Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, etc.) to improve workflow, content creation
and data analysis efficiency.
Preferred Qualifications
• Background in cross-border e-commerce, logistics technology, or supply chain SaaS industries
• Work or study experience in the US, with a deep understanding of American business culture and user habits
• Hands-on experience with B2B marketing
• Skilled at using AI tools (Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, etc.) to support marketing workflow automation

Data Engineer
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia · full time
Job Title: Data Engineer
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
About the Opportunity
Our client, a dynamic multinational company, is establishing a new global data engineering team to champion their
diverse digital initiatives and large-scale data projects. This is a ground-floor opportunity to join a creative,
motivated, and results-driven team in a role that offers a fantastic work-life balance.
This position is crucial for building and scaling the company's data analytics capabilities. They are seeking a
talented Data Engineer who is passionate about data and enjoys collaborating in a fun, high-impact environment.
Key Benefits & Perks
• Work-Life Balance: Hybrid work model (2 days work-from-home) and flexible shifts (e.g., 8:00-4:30, 9:00-5:30,
10:00-6:30).
• Compensation: Competitive salary, double pay, performance bonus, and overtime pay.
• Leave: Generous 14-20 days of annual leave.
• Health: Comprehensive medical, dental, and life insurance.
• Work Week: Standard five-day work week.
Core Responsibilities
• Architect, implement, and maintain the company's core data platform and innovative data solutions.
• Design, construct, and automate robust, modern data pipelines and real-time data streams.
• Develop and manage data models and schemas to facilitate efficient data integration and analysis.
• Proactively monitor, optimize, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT processes, identifying and implementing improvements
to enhance performance and efficiency.
• Collaborate closely with data analysts, data stewards, and business stakeholders to translate functional
requirements into technical specifications.
• Ensure high data quality and accuracy by performing rigorous data profiling, cleansing, and validation.
• Evaluate the performance and suitability of new data tools and technologies against business requirements.
• Contribute to related data initiatives, including data quality improvements and data education programs.
Required Qualifications
• Degree holder in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a relevant discipline.
• A minimum of 3 years of dedicated experience in data engineering.
• Expert-level proficiency in SQL is mandatory.
• Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks or Azure Synapse.
• Strong programming skills in a data-focused language (e.g., PySpark, Python, R, Java, Scala).
• Proven experience designing and deploying data applications on cloud solutions, specifically Azure.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and a strong data-driven mindset.
• Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
• Good communication skills in both written and spoken English.
• Willingness to travel as needed.
Preferred Qualifications (Advantages)
• Professional certification, such as Azure Data Engineer Associate.
• Knowledge of the wider Azure ecosystem (Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Event Hub) or Power BI.
• Experience in performance tuning and code optimization within Azure Databricks or Synapse.
• Experience preparing data for data science and machine learning models.
• Familiarity with DataOps principles.
• Prior experience working as part of a distributed global team.
How to Apply
To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your detailed resume for review.

Product Manager — WMS & Warehouse Integrations
Remote · full time
Why this role exists
The client is an AI-powered fulfilment and logistics ecosystem built for fast-growing e-commerce brands. From one
platform, merchants run global fulfilment, cross-border shipping, and AI logistics intelligence, with AI reducing
errors, lowering costs, and continuously optimising fulfilment and shipping as they scale globally. The ecosystem is
deliberately flexible: the client operates its own WMS for the warehouses it works with, and connects partner
warehouses and external WMS systems through the same platform.
Warehouse-side demand is growing fast: fulfilment accounts, white-label deals, and WMS-shaped RFPs from
prospects. The WMS domain now needs one dedicated owner: our own WMS, the partner WMS integrations, and
the Fulfillment API contract that connects any warehouse to the platform.
Scope of ownership
• All WMS product work, end to end: roadmap, PRDs, sizing with engineers, sprint delivery, QA of WMS flows.
• The whole WMS domain, current and future: our own WMS, partner warehouses and their WMS systems, and
the evaluation of new WMS partners or a next-generation in-house build.
• WMS delivery management day to day: integration specs, sync reliability (WMS to OMS inventory mirrors), bug
escalations with evidence, release coordination with the warehouse and the WMS development team.
• Warehouse-flavoured commercial support: WMS RFP gap analyses and feasibility answers for Sales on "can
the warehouse do X".
What the job is day to day
• Turn warehouse and fulfilment asks into scoped, sized cards engineers can pick up, and run them through the
two-week sprint cadence.
• Own inbound/outbound/inventory flows: receiving orders, pick-pack, dispatch, returns, carton and serial-number
handling, and inventory reconciliation between WMS and OMS.
• Manage the WMS development team hands-on: reproduce issues, bring log and database evidence rather than
symptoms, push for root-cause fixes over per-record patches, and keep a written record of every open issue and
commitment.
• Sit between warehouse operators, the WMS development team, merchants, and the client's engineers, and
keep all four aligned in writing.
• QA the flows yourself before they ship.
Requirements
• 3+ years product management on logistics, fulfilment, warehouse, or supply-chain software (WMS, OMS, 3PL
platform, or adjacent).
• Has shipped integration-heavy product: APIs, webhooks, vendor systems, data sync between platforms.
• Technical fluency: can read a technical spec and hold their own in an engineering discussion about states,
syncs, and edge cases.
• Evidence-first working style: verifies against logs, data, and code before asserting; claims come with proof
attached.
• Clear, structured written English documentation.
• Self-sufficient operator: runs the WMS scope end to end without needing day-to-day direction. Escalates
decisions, not tasks.
• Collaboration fit: works transparently, decisions recorded in writing, no silo-building.
Nice-to-haves
• Direct WMS vendor-management experience, from the implementation side or the vendor side.
• Has run warehouse ops or worked physically close to a warehouse floor.
• Has run a build-vs-buy evaluation or vendor RFP process before.
• Uses AI tools as a working method (specs, QA planning, analysis), not just chat.
• Written Chinese (strong plus: warehouse operations and the WMS development team communicate in Chinese).
Reporting and interfaces
• WMS priorities are set together within the product roadmap with the team.
• Works daily with: platform engineers, the WMS development team, warehouse partners, BD on
warehouse-shaped deals, and CS on fulfilment escalations, and with the owners of adjacent scopes wherever a

WMS change integrates with shipping, billing, or the merchant app.
First 90 days (success looks like)
• Owns our WMS, its development-team relationship, and the WMS-to-OMS inventory-sync reliability queue
outright, as the single point of contact.
• Ships one warehouse-side improvement end to end through the sprint process, including dry-run and warehouse
sign-off.
• Delivers the WMS platform recommendation (evolve our current WMS, adopt a new partner, or build
next-generation in-house), with an evaluated shortlist and evidence.
• Produces the WMS integration playbook: how a new warehouse or vendor gets connected, with gates and tests,
built on the Fulfillment API contract.
• Is the person Sales routes every "can the warehouse do X" question to.

Field Service Engineer (FSE)
Singapore, Singapore · full time · SGD 5,000 – 6,000 / month
JOB DESCRIPTION
Job Title: FIELD SERVICE ENGINEER (FSE)
THE ROLE:
We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled Field Service Engineer with hands-on experience in
semiconductor wafer fabrication (fab) equipment. The service engineer will be responsible for installation,
maintenance, troubleshooting & upgrading of semiconductor process tools to ensure maximum equipment uptime
& performance in customer production environment. Good communication skills, spoken & written.
This is a full-time position and reports directly to the Operations Director.
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:
The ideal candidate preferably has some years of experience in wafer fab sector, either working in the fab or
working in a major OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) such as Applied Materials (AMAT) or Tokyo Electron
Limited (TEL), or in some capacity in the wafer fab production process. Our focus products & services are in the
Diffusion & Thin Film (TF) module/dept.
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Perform installation, qualification & acceptance of company products & services.
• Troubleshoot and resolve on-site technical issues
• Support move-in equipment hook-up phase.
• Document service activities, prepare technical reports & maintain accuracy.
• Ensure service quality and compliance with EHS, and regulatory standards
• Maintain clear communication with customers and internal teams
CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS/SKILLS:
• Willingness to learn, with a service-oriented and positive attitude.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Communication skills to articulate problem statement
• Knowledge of semiconductor wafer fab process
• Major plus if candidate has knowledge of vacuum systems, robotics, pneumatic, etc.
QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:
• Diploma or degree in either Electrical & Electronic/Mechanical/Chemical engineering, or an equivalence in
working related experience
• 2-5 years experience working in semiconductor wafer fab environment is preferred.
• Fresh Graduates are welcome.
BENEFITS & OTHERS:
• Group medical and dental insurance; miscellaneous allowance
• Annual Wage Supplement (AWS) + Variable Bonus (P&L & individual performance)
• OJT
• Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
ABOUT THE CLIENT
The client specializes in used tool sales, RF spare parts repair, and consumable part supply for the semiconductor
wafer fabrication industry. Its Singapore-based workshop focuses on RF generator and high-value parts repair,
serving key 12" wafer fabs.
With expertise across modules such as Diffusion, Implant, PECVD, CMP, Etch, Wet, Inspect, Metro, AMAT
Centura, and TEL Furnace, the client continues to expand its technical capabilities and industry footprint.
The client is expanding rapidly and looking for dynamic team members who want to grow in this high-tech industry.

text:
Regional Lead Designer UI/UX
full time · MYR 10,000 / month
Job Description
Objective
The incumbent is responsible for designing visually appealing and user-centric interfaces for tech products,
collaborating with product managers and developers to define user requirements, create mockups, and optimize
user experiences. This role involves conducting user research, troubleshooting UX issues, and coaching
stakeholders on UI/UX best practices to enhance platform engagement, while supporting the Regional Lead, UI/UX
in maintaining design quality.
Position Responsibilities
User Experience and Design:
• Develop UI mockups and prototypes that align with branding guidelines and illustrate intuitive app/web GUI
designs.
• Design user navigation and interactions, supported by prototypes, to enhance user experience.
• Identify and resolve UX issues (e.g., responsiveness, user pain points) to improve platform usability.
• Conduct usability surveys and tests to gather user feedback and drive UI/UX improvements.
Product Strategy and Research:
• Gather and evaluate user requirements in collaboration with product managers to inform design decisions.
• Research competitors' digital products and stay updated on UX trends to propose innovative design solutions.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Work closely with mobile/web developers to fine-tune UI/UX implementations during development cycles.
• Lead UI/UX walkthroughs with internal teams and key stakeholders to ensure design alignment.
• Influence and educate business stakeholders on the importance of UI/UX and the rationale behind design
choices.
Mentorship and Leadership:
• Review and coach peers on UI/UX best practices, fostering learning and support within the design team.
Other Job Authorities:
• Support UX research by providing visual prototypes for user testing.
• Update design documentation and style guides to maintain consistency.
• Assist the Regional Lead, UI/UX in implementing design standards and processes.
• Monitor industry UI/UX trends to suggest enhancements to the design team.
Job Requirements
Qualification and Experiences
• Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
• Certification in UI/UX Design.
• 5+ years of UI/UX design experience in tech products, with a focus on web and mobile applications.
• Proven portfolio demonstrating UI mockups, prototypes, usability testing, and user-centered design solutions.
• Experience collaborating with product managers, developers, and stakeholders in Agile environments.
• Track record of coaching peers or stakeholders on UI/UX principles.
• Advanced proficiency in UI/UX design tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe XD) for creating mockups, prototypes, and
storyboards.
• Strong knowledge of user research methodologies, usability testing, and competitor analysis.
• Understanding of front-end development concepts (e.g., HTML, CSS, responsive design) to support developer
collaboration.
• Expertise in designing user navigation and interaction flows aligned with branding guidelines.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate design rationales to stakeholders
• Creative: Innovates to deliver engaging and intuitive interface designs.
• Collaborative: Builds strong partnerships with product managers, developers, and stakeholders.
• Detail-Oriented: Ensures precision in UI elements and adherence to design standards.
• Empathetic: Prioritizes user needs and feedback to drive design improvements.
